title: What's New in AL: Easy Access to Source Code with Open In VS Code and GitHub Projects (2024)

features.name: Open In VS Code action on extension management page
features.description: New action that allows developers to open the source code of an extension directly in VS Code from the extension management page, using GitHub repository information stored in the Source Control Details section.
caveats: Requires access to the GitHub repository
Does not work if resource protection policies prevent source download
User must have GitHub credentials configured

features.name: Source Control Details section in extension management
features.description: New section in the extension details page that displays the GitHub repository URL and commit ID associated with the extension build, enabling developers to find and access the source code.
caveats: Only populated for extensions built with AL-Go for GitHub
User must still have access to the repository

features.name: Explore page in VS Code from page inspector
features.description: The page inspector now allows developers to explore a specific page directly in VS Code, navigating to the exact page definition in the source code.

features.name: Automatic population of Source Control Details via AL-Go for GitHub
features.description: AL-Go for GitHub automatically populates the GitHub repository and commit information in the Source Control Details section for extensions built with this framework.
caveats: Only works for extensions built with AL-Go for GitHub
Requires proper configuration of AL-Go pipeline

features.name: Repository reopen functionality in VS Code
features.description: When opening an extension source that has been previously cloned, VS Code offers a reopen option to avoid re-cloning the repository, improving the workflow for developers who revisit the same source code.
